items.question: What special instruction must the moon-crested lord impart on that matter to the seeker?
premises: The moon-crested lord is addressed as the authoritative teacher.
The seeker explicitly requests instruction on a previously indicated matter.
The request emphasizes a special or particular explanation.
items.inference: The moon-crested lord is obliged to provide a specially focused teaching on that matter to the seeker.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tatra depends on the immediately preceding context.
items.plain_english: O moon-crested one, tell me especially about that matter.
